E0913

trait impl missing associated type (D-LIB2)

What

trait impl missing associated type (D-LIB2)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0913

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0913: tests/ui/missing_assoc_type.stderr.

Error [E0106]: the name `Tally` is built in and can't be redefined
  --> tests/ui/missing_assoc_type.jet:6:8
    |
  6 | struct Tally {
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: `Tally` is provided by the language itself
 Fix: choose a different name for this struct
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0106

Error [E0301]: `impl Tally` names a type that doesn't exist
  --> tests/ui/missing_assoc_type.jet:10:6
    |
 10 | impl Tally.Container {
    |      ^^^^^
 Why: `Tally` hasn't been defined as a struct or enum
 Fix: define `struct Tally` or `enum Tally` first
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0301

Error [E0913]: `impl …: Container` doesn't set `type Item`
  --> tests/ui/missing_assoc_type.jet:10:6
    |
 10 | impl Tally.Container {
    |      ^^^^^
 Why: `Container` declares an associated type each impl must define
 Fix: add `type Item = …` inside the impl block
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0913

Error [E0119]: there's no type called `Tally`
  --> tests/ui/missing_assoc_type.jet:6:8
    |
  6 | struct Tally {
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: the types are `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, and `String` (plus types you define)
 Fix: check the spelling, or define the struct or enum first
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0119

Error [E0302]: `.vals` only works on struct and tuple values
  --> tests/ui/missing_assoc_type.jet:6:8
    |
  6 | struct Tally {
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: enums and other values use methods or pattern tests instead
 Fix: use a struct or tuple value before `.vals`
